title: Chapter 50
text:
Han Xiao raised his eyebrows.

Trust took time to develop. Zhang Wei seemed aggressive, but he also proved that he was a captain who took his responsibilities seriously. Han Xiao was not angry.

However, it was impossible to kick him out of the team. Zhang Wei could not get past the higher-ups.

Zhang Wei knew that he could not go against the higher-ups' decision, but as the captain, he had to take the responsibility of leading the team. How could he lead the team when a newbie with no experience and no information was given to him? He knew almost nothing about Han Xiao.

The reason why Zhang Wei was angry was not because his position as the captain was being challenged, but because he felt that the higher-ups did not care about the safety of his team.

A newbie who was not capable enough could easily make the wrong decision and put the team in danger. Even if it was not intentional, it was still a black sheep.

Zhang Wei did not discriminate against newbies, but he felt that newbies had to go through at least two to three years of training before they were qualified to join the secret operations department. He did not want to lead newbies on missions.

Why were they stuffing all kinds of people into his team? What did they take his team for? A nanny?

They did not care about the safety of their subordinates at all. D * mn those in power!

Detestable, corrupt privileged class, eat my Salted Fish Spike!

Zhang Wei secretly made a decision. If Han Xiao could not fit in with the team, even if the higher-ups disliked him, he would definitely kick Han Xiao out of the team. At the very least, he would kick the ball to another team!

Han Xiao did not know what was going on in Zhang Wei's mind. He only noticed that Zhang Wei's eyes were getting more and more unfriendly. He did not know what this seemingly upright captain was thinking, but he felt that he had tricked someone else again …

At this time, Lin Yao's computer lit up. He turned his neck with difficulty and looked at it. His expression changed. "Sudden mission, the higher-ups want us to leave immediately!"

Zhang Wei's face turned serious. "What's the situation?"

"Ma Qing Yang's team was on a mission to attack the Germinal Organization base and was ambushed. The higher-ups want us to go and help them immediately. We will talk about the rest when we get on the plane."

Attack the Germinal Organization base? Han Xiao was stunned. Yes, this was the information he had given about the three bases. After thinking for a while, he could roughly guess what had happened.

The three Germinal bases that he had given were all located within Stardragon's territory. That was why Stardragon had been able to mobilize its troops in such a short time. Division 13 had already destroyed two of the Germinal bases within the borders of two countries, which increased his mission progress to 2.0%. No matter how stupid the Germinal Organization was, they would know that the information had been leaked. They would be prepared and set up an ambush at the third base.

Zhang Wei hurriedly walked out of the room. When he passed by Han Xiao, he paused and frowned. "Lin Yao, stay here and take over the logistics position. Han Xiao, you're a newcomer. This is a rare opportunity. You should learn from the side and try to be useful as soon as possible. "

Lin Yao wanted to say something but stopped. Han Xiao smiled and said casually, "Sure."

Zhang Wei did not participate in the Black Spider operation. Just based on Li Ya Lin's description, he did not trust Han Xiao. Han Xiao could understand human nature. He sighed inwardly. Who asked him to be such a considerate man?

Han Xiao thought for a while and stopped Li Ya Lin. He took out four magazines filled with high-explosive bullets and said, "Consider this a gift from me."

Li Ya Lin's eyes lit up. "Is this your new invention?"

"Use it sparingly." Han Xiao laughed and said mysteriously, "It will catch fire."

…

You have triggered Level E Mission [Rescue].

Mission Details: Rescue a secret service team that is being hunted down. Your duty is to assist your teammates in completing this mission.

Mission Requirement: Rescue Ma Qing Yang's team successfully.

Mission Reward: 8,000 EXP

Special Reward: None

Eight thousand EXP was better than nothing. It was another reward for the logistics.

"Brother Xiao, the captain is not targeting you on purpose. Don't take it to heart," Lin Yao said carefully.

"I know."

Hearing Han Xiao's natural tone, Lin Yao was relieved. He turned on the three computers and typed rapidly on the keyboard, adjusting the frequency of the mini cameras and mini headphones. The sound and image appeared at the same time, and the screen showed the three people's first-person perspective. The team had already boarded the plane.

The headquarters had an exclusive subway that could quickly transport people to the airport in the suburbs.

The three of them boarded the fighter jet, accompanied by a twelve-man field team. Han Xiao, Li Ya Lin, and Lin Yao chatted with each other. Zhang Wei and Lambert did not join them. They were resting with their eyes closed.

An hour later, the plane landed and arrived at the destination.

…

In the picture, there was a Gobi desert. The barren hills were continuous, like the spine of the earth. The sun was radiating light and heat in the blue sky. The air was distorted and floating under the high temperature. The yellow sand covered the ground was like a hot soldering iron, kissing the boots of the soldiers, emitting a slight burnt smell.

"We have arrived at the destination," Zhang Wei reported.

The three of them were fully armed. Li Ya Lin was still in her yellow hoodie and black bulletproof bodysuit. She had a retractable knife on her waist and a black backpack with a lightweight mechanical arm in it.

Lambert carried a few dozen retractable knives and a long, narrow sniper rifle.

However, Zhang Wei's weapon gave Han Xiao a shock. It was a personal power armor!

His entire body was covered in thick, grayish-black armor with scratches on it. His head was like the heavy helmets of ancient western knights, only revealing the eyes. The arm armor was equipped with hanging rails, carrying two modified and thick machine guns. The ammunition chain was hidden under the armor, and the replacement position was on the outside of his thigh, covering him tightly. There was also a hexagonal steel shield on its back. It looked like a tortoise's shell. It was very thick and looked very simple. It was obvious that this guy was the main tank.

Han Xiao's interest was piqued. "This is the prototype of the [Combatant Armor]. It's one of the few basic mechanical armors in Blue Star Version 1.0."

The Six Nations had different advanced knowledge and developed different unique weapons. These were the so-called faction specialties.

Theseus focused on the development of power armors, and the [Combatant Power Armor] was a small, full-cover power armor developed by Theseus after the open beta. It was the first power armor to appear on Planet Aquamarine, and it should not have been completed yet. Zhang Wei was only wearing the prototype, and he did not know how he got his hands on Theseus' equipment. Something must have happened.

Players could only buy this mechanical armor when they reached [Respected] status in the Theseus Faction. Moreover, it was very expensive. Just the repair fee after every battle would cost tens of thousands. The players could not earn as fast as Han Xiao.

As the support of the team, he was responsible for the equipment supply and maintenance. Zhang Wei's armor would be repaired by him in the future.

As long as there were no security measures, mechanics could reverse engineer the blueprint through the actual object. There were two situations.

First, if one had learned the prerequisite knowledge of the blueprint, the derivation speed would be greatly increased. Furthermore, the EXP required to understand the blueprint would be within an acceptable range.

Second, if one did not learn the prerequisite knowledge of the blueprint, they could still derive the blueprint. However, the progress was as slow as a snail, and the EXP required was astronomical. It was very common for the EXP required to derive the blueprint would be dozens of times higher. The blueprints they obtained would usually be labeled as' incomplete 'or' incomplete '.

The prerequisite knowledge of the [Combatant Armor] was the advanced knowledge of another Armed Branch, and it was in the hands of Theseus.

Han Xiao bit his nails. If he could derive the armor blueprint, even if it was incomplete, he would be able to obtain a new combat method. After all, armor greatly increased his combat ability.

However, after thinking about it for a while, he suppressed this thought. With his memory, he could integrate better mechanical blueprints and adapt to various requirements. It was not worth it to spend a huge amount of EXP to derive an incomplete armor blueprint.

Lin Yao said, "The rescue team is 13 kilometers away from us. There are 15 armored off-road vehicles and a Black Harrier in pursuit. The rendezvous point is the hill three kilometers away from you. Your mission is to stop the pursuers and rescue your teammates. Don't get caught up in the battle. I've already sent them the rendezvous point, so be prepared."

The order was clear. This was the job of the logistics and intelligence personnel. They were responsible for coordinating the overall situation and quickly coming up with suitable strategies for the combatants.

The three of them and the field team quickly arrived at the rendezvous point. They lay prone behind the hill and waited for the enemy to appear.

Soon, the roar of engines could be heard from afar. In the open desert, more than ten armored vehicles of the Germinal Organization were chasing after a vehicle. The sound of machine guns and grenades could be heard incessantly. The flames of the explosions chased after the fleeing vehicle, creating craters in the ground and filling the air with smoke.

The fleeing vehicle was Ma Qing Yang's team.

"Stand by!" Zhang Wei's tone was solemn as he stared at the shrinking distance. When they were within range, he said, "Open fire."

The field team hiding behind the hill suddenly fired a rain of steel bullets. Flames erupted from their guns, and the bullets that filled the sky hit the armor plates of the pursuing vehicles. Countless sparks flew, and the clanging sounds did not stop.

Faced with the surprise attack, the leading vehicles hurriedly swerved to avoid the attack. They almost flipped over due to the high speed.
